name: 2027 Photo Editing Software: Which One is Right for You
description: Compare photo editing software for 2027, including Lightroom, Photoshop, Luminar, Affinity and DxO. Find the right editor for your photography and workflow.

step.name: Check compatibility.
step.text: Check compatibility. Confirm your camera's RAW format, operating system, memory and graphics requirements.

step.name: Decide where originals live.
step.text: Decide where originals live. Local drives and cloud libraries need different storage and backup plans.

step.name: Test everyday adjustments.
step.text: Test everyday adjustments. Crop, set white balance, recover highlights, refine colour and make a local adjustment.

step.name: Judge the result.
step.text: Judge the result. Compare at normal viewing size, then inspect for halos, noise and unnatural textures.

step.name: Check the total commitment.
step.text: Check the total commitment. Compare annual cost, renewal prices, major upgrades, cloud storage and time-limited AI services.
